title: Rate Limits & Quotas

body.text: Every plan has a quota — bigger jobs use more — so
spend your quota on the work that's most worth it
: let the AI do the tedious, repetitive work (tests, docs, migrations), and keep the important architecture decisions for yourself.

example: "Worth it: 'write 30 test cases for this module' / Not worth it: a new task every time you change one character"

title: Quota-saving techniques

body.text: write complete instructions that finish in one pass · keep working in the same task instead of opening new ones · set up a good AGENTS.md to reduce repeated commands
— a vague instruction that takes 5 rounds of back-and-forth uses more quota than one clear instruction.

example: "Instead of 'fix the form' then 4 more fixes → write all conditions up front: validation, error state, loading, a11y"
